cover.alt: Rihanna stands centred against a deep blood-red backdrop, flanked by models Alton Mason and Omar Sesay in tailored black suits. She wears a sweeping floor-length white trench coat open over a minimal white string bikini, paired with thigh-high white leather boots, and holds a tall white cane. Her hair is a slicked, jet-black pixie-mullet, lips painted matte red. Mason holds an oversized white dome umbrella above her; Sesay carries a black briefcase. The mood is monumental, regal, and pristine — pure power dressing flipped into editorial drama. The bold black "DAZED" logotype dominates the top, with "The Reign Never Stops" stacked at right and "30th Anniversary Issue" running vertically.

The mood is monumental, regal, and pristine — pure power dressing flipped into editorial drama. The bold black "DAZED" logotype dominates the top, with "The Reign Never Stops" stacked at right and "30th Anniversary Issue" running vertically.

Rihanna poses in profile against a pitch-black backdrop, her gaze cutting back to camera in a sharp side-eye. She wears a glistening full-body gold catsuit textured in a perforated, scale-like graphic pattern — the metallic skin runs from neck to toe and continues into matching pointed gold boots. Her hair is a slicked, jet-black pixie-mullet (same as Cover 1), her lips a glossy nude-rose, cheekbones sculpted. One hand rests low on her hip, the other slides down the front of her thigh, legs planted wide in a statuesque, Bond-girl-meets-Midas power stance. The bold white "DAZED" logotype dominates the top, with "Rihanna photographed by Rafael Pavarotti" set small at the upper left and "30th Anniversary Issue" running vertically along the right edge. "The Golden Reign of Rihanna" anchors the bottom in clean serif white type.

Rihanna gazes straight into the camera against a deep crimson-red backdrop, bare-shouldered. Crowning her head is a towering, vertical column of slick jet-black hair — a sculptural, monolithic tower extending well past the top of the frame — finished with an oversized neon-green Louis Vuitton monogram baseball cap perched on top, its brim jutting out to the left. The beauty look is the editorial star: jewel-toned graphic eyeshadow blending cobalt blue, magenta and crimson, sharp winged liner, two shaved slashes carved through her right brow, glossy nude-bronze lips. Delicate ear piercings glint along her lobe; a fine script tattoo ("rebelle fleur") is visible at her collarbone. The bold white "DAZED" logotype sits top-centre, with "BEAUTY SPECIAL" small at the upper left, "Rihanna photographed by Rafael Pavarotti" beneath it, and "30th Anniversary Issue" rising vertically along the right edge. "New Heights" and "Rihanna" anchor the right side in serif white.
